articles.summary: Palitronica announced its work with Bell Textron Inc. to provide state-of-the-art cyber assurance to critical electronics for the Bell MV-75 Cheyenne II, formerly known as the U.S. Army’s Future Long-Range Assault Aircraft (FLRAA) program.
articles.title: Palitronica Supports Bell’s MV-75 Cheyenne Program with Cyber Assurance for Electronic Components
